title: Discount Taken on Equity Settled to an Estate Under Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
Settling a holding ahead of its cycle costs the cooperative capital, and it costs more where the equity has not yet stood long on the books.

**Where the holding is large and long-standing.** Where the equity standing is above 10 times the class's minimum equity balance and 10 or more capital retain lines stand on the equity ledger, the discount is 3 in the hundred.

**Where the holding is large but recent.** Where the equity standing is above 10 times the class's minimum equity balance and fewer than 10 capital retain lines stand on the equity ledger, the discount is 8 in the hundred.

**Otherwise.** The discount is the class's own estate retirement discount, as the class schedule of Membership and Patronage Equity carries it.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical figures

| Equity standing | Class minimum equity balance | 10 times that minimum | Capital retain lines standing | Discount |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 13440.00 | 1000.00 | 10000.00 | 12 | 3 in the hundred |
| 13440.00 | 1000.00 | 10000.00 | 9 | 8 in the hundred |
| 10000.00 | 1000.00 | 10000.00 | 12 | the class's own estate retirement discount |
| 6000.00 | 1000.00 | 10000.00 | 12 | the class's own estate retirement discount |
| 13440.00 | 1000.00 | 10000.00 | 10 | 3 in the hundred |

Two boundaries govern. Equity standing exactly at 10 times the class's minimum equity balance is not above it, and neither of the first two readings then holds. Capital retain lines standing at 10 reach the first reading; at 9 they do not.

**Worked.** Equity standing of 13440.00 discounted at 3 in the hundred leaves 13036.80; at 8 in the hundred it leaves 12364.80.
